_why: NIGHT67 builder T (T1a; slate T1a; FORGE67b code-scout.md section 3 #1, DECISIONS D-5 / R-5): the level table read by Tools/night/gen-slots.cjs --level <L>, Tools/night/n67-a1.cjs and the round tools (L67=<L>). Per level: the shipped (base) level and its plan, the new id, where its files live, its SLOTS (every fight room of the base plan, kind room; KEPT is computed: every other room, asserted bit for bit), the plan's piece lists (zone-keyed by `zone`, room-keyed by `room`; --check refuses a plan list not named here, so nothing is carried silently), the finish (data-name: levelgen's level with the base's data.name; foundry-a9: gen-n65-foundry.cjs's a9 keys), the openings seed (n59-l-room.py overlays the prefix's openings<NN>.json on n52's openings53.json: kiln's seed is n57's, so n67-kiln's old rooms keep n57's openings, code-scout.md section 2), the base level's own levelgen ERROR rows by check name (--run refuses only a row beyond them; --check proves the list equals the all-old assembly's report), the level row and its maps.list label. The foundry entry is level 1 on n65's paths: gen-slots.cjs --level foundry is gen-n65-foundry.cjs's assembler (its plan byte for byte: --check-foundry); level 1 keeps gen-n65-foundry.cjs as its tool tonight.

openings._why: NIGHT65 (generated by Tools/night/gen-n65-foundry.cjs from the room files in their slots; the lead's, never committed by a builder): n65-foundry's rooms whose room file sets an opening (vista / ambushed / ambusher / held), overlaid by Tools/night/n59-l-room.py on Design/levels/n52/openings53.json. A slot that holds n52's room (old), or a file with no opening, writes nothing here and keeps n52's.
